name: (Cryptid, Primeval) Stench
text:
30 feet. A creature entering the emanation or starting its turn in the emanation must succeed at a Fortitude save save against the standard DC for the creature's level or become Sickened 1 (plus Slowed 1 as long as it's sickened on a critical failure). While within the emanation, affected creatures take a -2 circumstance penalty to saves against diseases and to recover from the sickened condition. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Effect: Stench
